messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Autoscaler unable to provision GPUs in us-west1 (quota hits). Queue growth on /v1/generate observed; queued ~23k requests. Errors: GCP RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / quotaExceeded. Please acknowledge and follow GPU quota runbook.

alex: ack. paging oncall @sara — seeing big queue growth and high token latency. Root cause appears to be region quota exhaustion, autoscaler retries failing with 403/429 from GCP.

sara: oncall here, taking. I'm pulling allocation logs now. Preliminary: autoscaler requested 8 nodes, GCP returned RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED for nvidia-t4 and a few nvidia-a100 SKUs. Autoscaler then backed off and we hit scale-saturation.

omar: adding context — traffic spike from a few high-concurrency customers and a new internal load test from devex. The spike pushed sustained GPU utilization to 98% in us-west1 and exhausted our soft quotas.

dina: mitigation plan (immediate): 1) shift non-enterprise traffic away from us-west1 to us-central1; 2) enable smaller quantized model variant for heavy routes; 3) reduce default batch_size and concurrency. I'll make the routing changes now.

matt: opening GCP support case and quota request now. Case link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/123456789 (publicly accessible to our team). Requesting emergency quota bump + expedite.

cloud-ops: attempted manual pool creation (preemptible T4 pool) via terraform — failed with 403 quota. Snippet from terraform apply:
```
Error: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS_ALL_REGIONS' exceeded. Required '8', available '0'.
```
We can't manually allocate until quota increases or we move workloads.

alex: routing change snippet I'm applying to edge router:
```
PATCH /routing
{
  "route_filter": "tier:free",
  "fallback_region": "us-central1",
  "max_concurrency": 1
}
```
I'll roll non-critical tenants first.

sara: note on customer impact — current degraded impact summary: ~3 enterprise customers with pinned region config are experiencing increased latency and 2 with request throttling errors. Overall percent of requests affected is ~6% of global traffic. CS should notify those customers.

cs: drafting customer message now. Short note: "We're experiencing capacity constraints in us-west1 affecting generation latency for a subset of customers. We've shifted some workloads to alternate regions and enabled reduced-size model variants; we're also working with our cloud provider to restore capacity. We'll update in 30 minutes or sooner." Will post after Alex approves.

omar: toggled model fallback for heavy routes: redwood-70b -> redwood-70b-quant and redwood-7b -> redwood-7b-quant for free/standard tiers. This should reduce GPU memory pressure by ~40% and help throughput.

dina: also reduced default batching policy for affected routes to minimize tail latency: batch_window 10ms -> 2ms, max_batch_tokens 2048 -> 1024.

matt: confirmed CS notified the three enterprise customers with pinned-region constraints. Also tracked remediation: quota request submitted (urgent), model fallbacks enabled, routing shifted, batch sizes reduced. Monitoring for queue drain.

alex: handoff: i'm on-call for another 20m then handing to @omar for night. @sara can you post a short runbook note summarizing what you did for the handover? Include links to quota case and dashboard.

sara: will do. Handoff notes: 1) quota case #123456789 (critical), 2) routing policy changed to fallback us-central1 for non-pinned customers, 3) model fallbacks enabled, 4) batch sizing tightened, 5) monitoring alerts adjusted (queue_size, gpu_util). Leaving dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/gpu-queues?orgId=1

incident-bot: Incident created INC-20260314-78 severity=P1. Runbook used: gpu-quota-exhaustion. Next update in 10m. :thumbsup:
